opening: The damaged astrolabe had passed through the municipal conservation workshop’s intake room, imaging bay, solvent room, fiber lab, quarantine cabinet, and finishing studio before anyone understood how much of its trail had been lost to water. Access slips, instrument logs, conservation notes, camera timestamps, cart movements, and protocol acknowledgments survived in uneven fragments. Rather than trust seniority or first impressions, the incident panel rebuilt the record by the workshop’s stated rules.

scenes.prose: Before the names were compared, the panel read the governing page aloud beside the blotched intake folder. For this incident, the board declared the certified restoration lead protocol active; ordinary rank and reputation did not count. To keep damaged labels from inviting private interpretations, the panel fixed one shared status scale for the whole inquiry: open counted as 0; stable counted as 1; waking counted as 2; dormant counted as 3; latent counted as 4; clear counted as 5. The local tally began at 11. The worksheet required six streams—relation, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol—in that order, with coefficients 7, 11, 3, 5, 2, and 13. At each stream, the panel squared the current tally, added that stream’s coefficient times its status value, and kept the remainder modulo 97. It made three passes: first in the stated order, then in reverse order with the coefficients reversed, then once more in the stated order with the coefficient list rotated one place left. Without resetting the tally, it repeated that complete three-pass cycle 120 times.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 1

scenes.prose: At the pairing table, a conservator dried the recovered sheet under glass while another compared it with the apprentice records. The pairing sheet left Parker Andersen’s apprentice lineage dormant. Even the damaged roster still marked Val Rossi’s apprentice lineage as waking. They then moved to the clock cabinet: a clock-backed entry listed Tatum Hassan’s work interval as clear. In the solvent-room file, the chemical response that followed Indigo Rossi registered as stable, while causal review marked Sawyer Sato’s chemical response clear. The route team reconstructed the artifact’s passage through the workshop: door and route checks placed Parker Andersen’s workshop room at dormant, and corridor witnesses put Val Rossi’s workshop room at stable. At the imaging desk, reconstruction kept Tatum Hassan’s treatment order open. Finally, a close photograph of the token set Indigo Rossi’s tool stamp to latent, while the final count showed Sawyer Sato’s tool stamp remained clear.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 2

scenes.prose: A second packet came loose from the quarantine cabinet, and the panel asked a roster witness to read it before anyone tried to repair the torn corners. The witness who checked the roster left Indigo Rossi with a latent apprentice lineage; on the sealed worksheet, clerks wrote stable beside Sawyer Sato’s apprentice lineage. Clocked entries put Parker Andersen’s work interval at open, whereas the sequence sheet showed Val Rossi’s work interval as stable. Downstream checks tied Tatum Hassan to a dormant chemical response. A movement sketch marked Indigo Rossi’s workshop room as waking, and the route ledger tied Sawyer Sato’s workshop room to clear. In the finishing studio’s ordered log, Parker Andersen’s treatment order appeared as stable; the ordered sheet showed Val Rossi’s treatment order as clear. Inventory then counted Tatum Hassan’s tool stamp as stable.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 3

scenes.prose: The remaining gaps were checked against the instrument cart and its sealed movement envelope. In the earlier pairing note, Tatum Hassan carried an open apprentice lineage. After the timesheet review, Indigo Rossi’s work interval stayed waking, while reconciled timing notes kept Sawyer Sato’s work interval at latent. The instruments tracing Parker Andersen’s action left the chemical response latent; when Val Rossi acted, the chemical response came back open. Location review left Tatum Hassan’s workshop room open. At the sequence board, notes placed Indigo Rossi’s treatment order at dormant, and sequence review kept Sawyer Sato’s treatment order waking. Token and seal checks left Parker Andersen’s tool stamp at waking; the sealed check showed Val Rossi’s tool stamp as open.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 4

scenes.prose: With the six evidence streams assembled from the rooms and their records, the panel ran the prescribed calculation without allowing a damaged label to be silently replaced. For this incident, the accepted tally was 44. The final definition was strict: the certified restoration lead was the one person whose six-stream tally equaled the accepted tally. No title, confident testimony, or attractive provenance theory could substitute for that result.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 5

title: Certified Restoration Lead — Case 10005
